subtitle: Heal. Grow. Awaken.
promotionalText: Twenty-four guided sessions in meditation, shadow work, chakra healing and Reiki, with journaling, affirmations and breathwork. Three are free.
description:
Divine Healing by Strawberry Hope brings meditation, shadow work, chakra healing and Reiki into one place, so you can sit down and begin without first deciding where to start.

TWENTY-FOUR GUIDED SESSIONS
From five-minute resets to twenty-two-minute journeys: anxiety release, inner child work, heart healing, energy clearing, morning and evening practice, sleep meditation and more. Audio keeps playing when you leave the app or lock the phone, so you can close your eyes and put it down.

SHADOW WORK WITH JOURNALING
Seven reflection prompts accompany the shadow work sessions. What you write is saved privately to your account and is waiting when you come back to it.

A MANIFESTATION PRACTICE
Five questions, written out: what you want, why you want it, who you become when you have it, what changes, and the one action you take next.

AFFIRMATIONS AND BREATHWORK
Twenty affirmations to keep as favourites, and seven breathing techniques for when you need to steady yourself in a few minutes.

REIKI AND SPIRITUAL AWAKENING
Readings on Reiki and on the awakening process, each with prompts to reflect on — and you can book a session with Strawberry Hope directly from the app.

START FREE
Browse the whole library without an account. Three sessions are open to everyone. A subscription unlocks all twenty-four, every written exercise, and everything added later.

Subscription is CAD $19 per month or CAD $149 per year, each with a seven-day free trial. Cancel any time.
